description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'Switches' that demonstrates the usage of the Switch widget. It sets a listener on a switch to display a toast message when its checked state changes.

classes.name: Switches
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating Switch widget usage, including setting a checked change listener and displaying toast messages.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and sets a listener on the switch.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles the switch's checked state change by showing a toast message indicating the switch state.
